title: LIAR GAME

opinions.point: Community members strongly praised Nao’s character growth, confidence, and increasingly clever approach.
Many enjoyed the episode’s mind games and found Nao’s bluffing and confrontation especially satisfying.
Several commenters liked the evolving dynamic between Nao and Akiyama and appreciated Nao being able to support him.
Viewers were enthusiastic about Fukunaga’s continued involvement and the setup for the next game.
Some felt Nao’s earlier characterization was frustrating, while still agreeing that her development has substantially improved the series.
A few commenters worried that the next stretch may have reduced tension because the expected direction feels predictable.
Some criticism remained around Nao’s lingering insecurity and dependence on others.

title: Grand Blue Season 3

thread.title: Grand Blue Dreaming Season 3 • Grand Blue Season 3 - Episode 7 discussion

opinions.point: Many commenters enjoyed the episode’s unusually heartfelt character work and the emotional payoff.
The comedy was still praised, especially the awkward social situations and the contrast between serious moments and the show’s usual chaos.
Several commenters liked the focus on Iori’s unexpectedly caring side and the apparent romantic development.
Some viewers appreciated seeing diving return and found the underwater material visually appealing.
A number of commenters felt the mother-daughter conflict was resolved too indirectly and wanted a more direct conversation.
One commenter considered this the least funny arc so far and found the season comparatively bland.
